character: A man in his late thirties, very broad and heavily built, grey-green skin, a heavy brow, deep-set dark eyes. Black hair cropped close to the skull. The lower left tusk is chipped short. Old pale scarring across one forearm. A flat measuring expression, mouth closed
wardrobe: lightweight steel scale over worn brown leathers, plain and undecorated, a brass badge riveted to one shoulder strap, every buckle scuffed grey at the edges

full.framing: Full body standing portrait, front view, standing square with arms folded, plain neutral background.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer directly, chin level.

scene.framing: A trainer standing in a low timber hall built out over water, wooden practice posts and racked blunted weapons around him, sleeves pushed back, one hand raised mid-instruction, dawn light coming in flat off the river.
